normal.name: Viðrir 🗡️
normal.text: #Epicgames have launched it's first official #LinuxGaming client in beta and have announced that #Fortnite is coming officially to Linux. Cool right? They brag that they have vibe-coded the whole thing, not sure why they do that (brag), because... it's really shit! The AppImage thing is really stupid, just give me a repo to add guys! Also, what's up with this big space of nothing? And did I mention that I'm not able to launch any games? They should just have forked the Heroic Launcher 😜

normal.name: Gaute 👾 Holmin
normal.text: OK, jeg bryr meg egentlig katta om #Fortnite, men dette er stort! Epic Games annonserte akkurat inne i en nerdete bloggpost om Linux og anti-cheat at Fortnite kommer til :tux: Dette gjør #LinuxGaming til et mye mer reelt alternativ til Windows, for når Fortnite støtter Linux, så kommer mange andre MMO-spill til å komme etter. Kanskje 2027 virkelig blir "the year of the Linux Desktop" :redghost:
